answer_1.quote: We generate two types of behavioural tests: question answering (QA) and text completion. For QA, we prompt GPT-4 to generate n common questions about the concept... For text completion, we obtain Wikipedia articles about every concept and then sample a maximum number of m paragraphs per concept...
answer_1.outputs: Answers to concept-related questions and text completions based on Wikipedia paragraphs

answer_2.quote: For behavioural evaluation, we use our collected QA pairs and text completion queries... reporting the average BLEU and Rouge-L scores.
